results.name: Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
results.source_text:
theorem natDegree_mul_le {p q : R[X]} : natDegree (p * q) ≤ natDegree p + natDegree q := by
  apply natDegree_le_of_degree_le
  apply le_trans (degree_mul_le p q)
  rw [Nat.cast_add]
  apply add_le_add <;> apply degree_le_natDegree

results.name: Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le
results.source_text:
theorem natDegree_sum_le (f : ι → S[X]) :
    natDegree (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ s.fold max 0 (natDegree ∘ f) := by
  simpa using! natDegree_multiset_sum_le (s.val.map f)

results.name: Polynomial.natDegree
results.docstring: `natDegree p` forces `degree p` to ℕ, by defining `natDegree 0 = 0`.

results.name: Polynomial.natDegree_add_le_iff_left
results.source_text:
theorem natDegree_add_le_iff_left {n : ℕ} (p q : R[X]) (qn : q.natDegree ≤ n) :
    (p + q).natDegree ≤ n ↔ p.natDegree ≤ n := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => natDegree_add_le_of_degree_le h qn⟩
  refine natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr fun m hm => ?_
  convert! natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mp h m hm using 1
  rw [coeff_add, natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mp qn _ hm, add_zero]

results.name: Polynomial.natDegree_mul'
results.source_text:
theorem natDegree_mul' (h : leadingCoeff p * leadingCoeff q ≠ 0) :
    natDegree (p * q) = natDegree p + natDegree q :=
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := mt leadingCoeff_eq_zero.2 fun h₁ => h <| by rw [h₁, zero_mul]
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := mt leadingCoeff_eq_zero.2 fun h₁ => h <| by rw [h₁, mul_zero]
  natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some <| by
    rw [degree_mul' h, Nat.cast_add, degree_eq_natDegree hp, degree_eq_natDegree hq]

results.name: ZMod.val_lt
results.source_text:
theorem val_lt {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (a : ZMod n) : a.val < n := by
  cases n
  · cases NeZero.ne 0 rfl
  exact Fin.is_lt a

results.name: ZMod.val_cast_zmod_lt
results.source_text:
theorem val_cast_zmod_lt {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (a : ZMod m) :
    (a.cast : ZMod n).val < m := by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne m)
  by_cases! h : m < n
  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
    rw [← natCast_val, val_cast_of_lt]
    · apply a.val_lt
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ZMod.val_lt a)) h
  · apply lt_of_lt_of_le (ZMod.val_lt _) (le_trans h (Nat.le_succ m))

results.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_modMonomial_of_le
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_modMonomial_of_le {s' s : σ →₀ ℕ} (x : MvPolynomial σ R) (h : s ≤ s') :
    coeff s' (x %ᵐᵒⁿᵒᵐⁱᵃˡ s) = 0 :=
  x.coeff_modOf_of_exists_add _ _ <| exists_add_of_le h

results.name: MvPolynomial.coeff_modMonomial_of_not_le
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_modMonomial_of_not_le {s' s : σ →₀ ℕ} (x : MvPolynomial σ R) (h : ¬s ≤ s') :
    coeff s' (x %ᵐᵒⁿᵒᵐⁱᵃˡ s) = coeff s' x :=
  x.coeff_modOf_of_not_exists_add s s' <| by rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩; exact h le_self_add

results.name: Polynomial.monomial
results.source_text:
/-- `monomial s a` is the monomial `a * X^s` -/
def monomial (n : ℕ) : R →ₗ[R] R[X] where
  toFun t := ⟨.single n t⟩
  map_add' x y := by simp [← ofFinsupp_add]
  map_smul' r x := by simp [← ofFinsupp_smul]
results.docstring: `monomial s a` is the monomial `a * X^s`

results.name: WithDim.instAddCommSemigroup
results.source_text:
instance (d : Dimension) (M : Type) [AddCommSemigroup M] :
    AddCommSemigroup (WithDim d M) where
  add_comm m1 m2 := by
    ext
    simp [add_comm]

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
